title: Why can't I see any quests?
description: Quests are dynamically showed to you, they will appear as you progress and do specific stuff like acquiring a certain item. If you want to work on a particular mod, I'd suggest trying to find it's most basic resource and going to farm it, this will usually start you on the quest line; most of the quests have linear progression with sidequest lines on certain actions. honestly just have fun, the quests are mostly there to let you learn stuff.
